translationRepairs: That month Jiujiang suffered great famine; one in fourteen or fifteen people ate human flesh.
That month Jiujiang suffered great famine; four or five out of ten people ate human flesh.
s0048’s famine formula 人相食十四五 uses 十四五 as four or five tenths (什四五), the standard dynastic proportion, not one person in fourteen or fifteen; the replacement restores that sense.
That month Prince Lun of Shaoling came from Xunyang to Xiakou; Jingzhou inspector Prince Ke of Nanping yielded the province to him.
That month Prince Lun of Shaoling came from Xunyang to Xiakou; Yingzhou inspector Prince Ke of Nanping yielded the province to him.
s0082 has 郢州刺史; 郢州 is Yingzhou, distinct from Jingzhou (荊州), so the replacement corrects the province name without other change.
On jiawu in the eighth month Prince Yi of Xiangdong sent Army Inspector General Wang Senbian with troops to press Yingzhou.
On jiawu in the eighth month Prince Yi of Xiangdong sent Army Inspector General Wang Sengbian with troops to press Yingzhou.
s0090 names 王僧辯; 僧 is Seng, and Sengbian is the conventional romanization, so Senbian is a mistranscription of that syllable.

On guwei in the fifth month Prince Yi of Xiangdong urgently sent mobile corps general Hu Sengyou and Xin province inspector Lu Fahe to relieve Baling; Hou Jing sent Ren Yue with an army to block them.
On guwei in the fifth month Prince Yi of Xiangdong sent mobile corps general Hu Sengyou and Xin province inspector Lu Fahe to relieve Baling; Hou Jing sent Ren Yue with an army to block them.

Chapter s0106’s 湘東王驛遣 is a graphic corruption of 湘東王繹遣; 驛 is not an urgency adverb. Liangshu juan 5’s parallel for the same relief of Baling is simply 世祖遣, confirming Prince Yi sent the force without ‘urgently’.
Western Wei raided Anlu, seized Sizhou Inspector Liu Zhongli, and wholly lost the lands east of the Han.
Western Wei raided Anlu, seized Sizhou Inspector Liu Zhongli, and wholly took the lands east of the Han.
In s0071 Western Wei is the subject of 寇…執…盡沒; 沒 here means the lands east of the Han were wholly taken/annexed, so ‘wholly lost’ reverses the agent’s action.
